_about: Town arcade institution record: an interior (#119) in a town plus a game roster. Distinct from #56's Garden minigame token loop (Garden venue, care verbs, garden_token) and #88's Garden attractions. Games are content slots in this format — none are designed here. The ethics are enforced by MISSING FIELDS: the record has no wager field, no second-currency field, and no real-money field.

ethics.no_gambling: a chance-based game is skill-priced or free. Skill-priced = the fixed fee (#20 currency) buys PLAY; price and prize are never linked by chance (a pay-then-chance-decides game is a wager — unrepresentable here). A purely chance game (wheel, drawing) must be FREE to play.
ethics.no_power_prizes: #56 M1 inherited — prize rows: cosmetic / care / decor / material-class #31 items + #104 honour-class stamps only. Never stats, Fragments, move access, or progression goods.
ethics.no_pressure: no expiring prizes, no streak punishment (#56 M4 / #124 no-pressure law) — rotation makes games return, never vanish
ethics.one_currency: prices denominate only in #20's single currency (#20 forbids a second currency without an owner ruling); #56's garden_token is Garden-scoped and does not circulate in towns; no real-money anything, ever (#56 M4)

game_record.inputClass: skill | chance | mixed — declared honestly per game; the ethics key off it
game_record.name: display name via #23 lookup
game_record.price: fixed session fee in #20 currency, or free — never a wager

prizeTable.prize: #31 item id | #104 honour-stamp occasion ref (occasions proposed into #104's catalogue home)

game_record.rotation: #124 rotation entry ref (featured scheduling; availability derived at read time)

open_register: every game's design, input-class ruling, and price
every prize table's contents + #104 stamp occasions (owner's catalogue slot)
whether any chance-class game exists at all
